title: Paid Time Off Policy
text: Full-time employees accrue 20 days of paid time off (PTO) per year, accrued monthly at 1.67 days per month. New hires may begin using PTO after their first 90 days of employment. Up to 5 unused PTO days may be carried over into the following calendar year; any excess is forfeited on December 31. PTO requests must be submitted in Workday at least 2 weeks in advance for absences longer than 3 days. PTO is separate from sick leave.

title: Sick Leave Policy
text: Employees receive 10 paid sick days per year, available from day one of employment. Sick days do not carry over year to year. For any absence longer than 3 consecutive days, a doctor's note must be submitted to HR. Sick leave can be used for the employee's own illness or to care for an immediate family member. Notify your manager by 9am on the day of a sick absence.

title: Remote Work & Hybrid Policy
text: Acme operates a hybrid model: employees are expected in the office Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, and may work remotely on Monday and Friday. Fully remote arrangements require VP approval and are reviewed annually. Remote employees must be reachable on Slack during core hours of 10am to 4pm in their local time zone. The company provides a one-time 500 dollar home-office stipend, claimable through Expensify.

title: Expense Reimbursement
text: Submit expenses through Expensify within 30 days of purchase. Expenses over 75 dollars require an itemized receipt. Meals during business travel are reimbursed up to 60 dollars per day. Software or SaaS purchases must be pre-approved by your manager and the IT department. Reimbursements are paid out with the next payroll cycle after approval. Personal travel and alcohol are not reimbursable.

title: Requesting a New Laptop or Equipment
text: To request a new laptop or hardware, open a ticket in the IT Service Desk portal and select 'Hardware Request'. Standard issue is a 14-inch MacBook Pro; Windows machines are available on request for engineering roles. Replacement cycles are every 3 years. For a lost or stolen device, notify IT Security immediately at security@acme.com so the device can be remotely wiped. Loaner laptops are available for same-day pickup at the IT desk on floor 3.

title: Resetting Your Password & MFA
text: To reset your Acme password, go to id.acme.com and click 'Forgot password'; a reset link is sent to your recovery email. Passwords must be at least 12 characters and are rotated every 90 days. Multi-factor authentication (MFA) via the Okta Verify app is mandatory for all accounts. If you are locked out or lose your MFA device, contact the IT Service Desk at extension 4357 (HELP) to verify your identity and re-enroll.

title: New Hire Onboarding
text: New hires complete onboarding over their first week. Day one: collect your laptop from IT on floor 3, set up Okta and MFA, and complete I-9 verification with HR. Within the first week, finish the required security-awareness and code-of-conduct training in the Learning portal. Your manager will schedule a 30-60-90 day plan. Benefits enrollment must be completed within 30 days of your start date or you wait until open enrollment.

title: Health Benefits & Enrollment
text: Acme offers medical, dental, and vision insurance through Blue Shield. The company covers 80 percent of the employee premium and 50 percent of dependent premiums. Coverage begins on the first of the month following your start date. Open enrollment runs each November for the following year. Qualifying life events (marriage, birth, adoption) allow benefit changes within 30 days of the event. A 401k with a 4 percent company match is available after 60 days.

title: Reporting a Security Incident
text: If you suspect a security incident - a phishing email, malware, a lost device, or a data leak - report it immediately to security@acme.com or via the '#security-alerts' Slack channel. Do not attempt to investigate or forward suspicious emails; use the 'Report Phishing' button in Outlook. The security team triages all reports within 1 hour during business hours. Never share your password or MFA codes with anyone, including IT staff who will never ask for them.

title: Booking Business Travel
text: Book all business travel through the Navan (formerly TripActions) portal to stay within policy. Flights under 6 hours must be booked in economy; business class requires VP approval. Hotels are capped at 250 dollars per night in most cities and 350 dollars in New York and San Francisco. Book at least 14 days in advance when possible for better rates. Rental cars require you to decline the rental company's insurance, as Acme's corporate policy covers it.
